intro: Night one in Saigon. The eclipse hangs over Landmark 81, and the river glows the wrong colour.
The Dragon Pearl rests on its lotus dais in the park. If the hungry ghosts reach it, its light goes out.
The oldest teaching comes first: plant Sacred Rice. Every stalk grows Rice Gems, and the gems pay for every other seed.
Then put Lotus Shooters in front of it. Ghosts eat the nearest plant, so give them one that bites back.
huge_wave: Here comes the hungry crowd. Hold the line!
outro: Dawn over the river. The ghosts were not cruel, only starving. Tomorrow night they will come back hungrier.
